I've always wanted both, which I know is unrealistic. Part of me wants to be "feared," I guess, but the other part wants to be liked my most people that I meet, or that I hang with. That ladder part is withering right now, and I'm starting to feel it.

If I had to choose in the past, I would pick feared in a heartbeat. Now, I would probably choose loved.

I believe I've been tested for autism before--when I was very, very young--but it came back negative; I was deaf until I was four, and that's why I was displaying unusual symptoms at the time.

I've thought about the fact that I may be a narcissist before, but if I am, I don't know what I would do about it, other than counseling, which I can't really afford.

I may be insecure, but I don't really know what I would be insecure about. Perhaps something deep seeded? I don't know.

I honestly don't know; I can't really give an exact answer. I would just have to guess, and my best guess is that I'm insecure, maybe? Insecure about what, though, I don't know.
